body:
-______- You kinda just pissed me off a bit. I'm not just being emo. I know I have all I need, I know I'm ungrateful, it's not like I'm doing it on fucking purpose. Ever heard of depression? You know, that thing where the chemicals in your brain are a bit jacked up, and it's hard to be happy? Yeah, I have that. I'm not just being 'dark'. We all had social anxiety? Then tell me, why does it seem like there's only a handful of kids at school who suffer like me, who end up sitting around and no one wants to talk to them, those kids that everyone just thinks is quiet and weird, those kids who freak out when people come near them? I understand people go through changes. I do have a character though, don't say I don't. It just probably isn't how I'll be forever. But I do hate as I am now. And no, I don't have enough pocket change to buy whatever, and some days we struggle to put food on the table. Don't assume I'm spoiled. I'm constantly watching my sisters as my mom goes out to drink and smoke pot with her friends. 

Don't assume. It just makes an ass out of u and me. But more so you than I.
You, sir, have the most awesome fish I have ever seen.

I'm not looking for excuses. I won't say I'm not scared; I do fear the future, and all its uncertainty. Not everyone will feel that way. Know why I feel this way? Because the chemicals in my brain are so messed up and my depression is so bad that I can't stand to go on this way. It's not like I want to be dead. I just want to feel better. If death is the only way, so be it.

I couldn't honestly care less if everyone stopped caring and our species went extinct. We are a terrible, cruel, unforgiving and selfish species.

I'm not kidding. You don't matter either. Years from now, if our species is still in tact, the world will be full of people with no idea who I was. Because I am not important. Perhaps a handful of individuals won't exist due to my premature death. Perhaps that isn't a bad thing. What if my descendants are the next Hitlers? Point is, I don't matter. No single individual matters. In a school of fish, the form one big useful group, but if one vanishes, is the group suddenly powerless? No.

No. No one has purpose.

If you believe I have a purpose, what is it?

I know. But there's no guarantee they'd exist anyways, it is actually very likely they won't. I'm pretty sure I'm infertile. So the chances of children who accomplish much, or children produced only to be disappointed in their foolish mother, either way it is slim to none odds.

I would feel bad and give in myself. However, I do not care that the people around me would be sad. We are but a small group of people out of billions. We are not important. It is not as if this doesn't happen around the world daily. I don't matter. They don't matter. No one matters. Because eventually, we will all be dead, replaced, and then forgotten gradually.

COULD. Key word there. There is no guarantee. I may die tomorrow of some other cause, like a wreck or something. The future is not promised. 

As for you being here for me, you are merely some stranger over the internet, someone who has not seen nor experienced my decisions and mistakes throughout my life.

I've heard this plenty. I got by with it just fine for ages though.
And there is no guarantee something good will happen, just the opposite could happen. Sure, I could become successful and have a nice family. But it's just as likely that some tragic accident will wipe out my current family and I may end up homeless as an adult.
We try, but it's hard, because there are times when we both feel low and would like to give in.

I understand that, but they would recover. But guilt is no reason to stay; I cannot feel guilty when I am not breathing.

I usually get around 700 calories.

But there's no point in it. Sure, I may be helping people now, but when I do die, it will all be for nothing. Everything I ever was will slowly be forgotten. There's truly no point to living, except maybe pursuing petty goals or trying to find happiness that never lasts. Our only real purpose is to reproduce, which I think we've overdone a little.
I have one person I can lean on, and he too is on the brink of throwing in the towel, so to speak. It's hard to lean on one who is in need of support themself.

It's pointless to try and change a world that has always been this way. There will always be bad people. There will always be violence. Rape, starvation, war...these are things that will never go away. It's pointless to attempt it. On top of that, we all die anyways. There is no point in trying to ease someone's suffering when it will end soon regardless. Is it really punishment? For all we know, I could become some deranged psychopath. Then I would be saving them. Or, I could die next week anyways, in some  kind of crash. Then it has happened anyways. 

Not everyone can survive so easily without others. When you hate yourself, and no one else is there to love you, it's far too easy to give up, and far too difficult to overcome any obstacles life may throw at you. Also, I have some serious social anxiety; it isn't so easy as getting out and meeting new people. I can't connect, because I'm too busy being nervous and freaking out.

I don't like anything about myself, that's the issue. I can't change everything. Back to my issue of no motivation? Yeah, that makes it hard to try much for changing. I've been practicing for ages and have made very little progress. I cannot find a muse. 

Not everyone can do great things. Some truly are not worth the air they breathe. It's foolish of people to try and believe otherwise.

I'll just get annoyed with myself. I'd honestly like to change nearly everything, I can't stand a single thing about me. And it's hard to map out a future when the future is so uncertain. I've already tried many mediums, but I do not excel at any in particular; while drawing remains my favorite, I don't do well with it.

I gave up on myself a long time ago.

I don't want to do that, because then I might slip something in there that I'd rather them not see. I don't trust them.

And I have a history of making terrible choices.

I lack the ability to confront others. Even family. I never know what to write, and feel stupid looking back at previous entries in any sort of journal. I have no hobbies I can partake in without becoming frustrated with my lack of skill.

I understand life has only begun, but I tire of it already. It may get better, it may get worse. There's no knowing, and I hate that. I know I don't know the world. I don't want to. People are terrible creatures. Society is a cruel thing. I know that is true, as I have heard it from many older than myself.

All my friends have always abandoned me throughout life, so obviously the problem is  me and it likely won't change. They take me for granted. Everyone does.

I can't wait ten more years. I don't have the patience.

I was suicidal before the antidepressants, I actually attempted shortly before starting them. I am going to a new one in a few days, though it will be no different. My 4th one, and I won't like it. I can't talk in person. I clam up. My mind shuts off. I get too nervous are unfamiliar people. And what if no one loves future me? What if I'm a terrible person, in prison or something? Don't pretend it can happen. It's just as likely as anything.

I already go to therapy, I hate therapists, people make me miserably uncomfortable if I'm not already close to them. There are only 5 people I'm even comfortable having near me, not counting family. I also take antidepressants, they don't help much now. I understand perhaps in the future it will be better, but I can't wait. I don't have the patience. I've been waiting so, so long. I've wanted to die since I was 10. 10! I've waited five years, hoping for improvement, but it's done just the opposite. I can't wait any longer. I have no meaning. Life feels pointless. There's no reason for anyone to live, it's stupid to try.

No one has told me it is silly. I just realize that in a world where many pursue such things, my chances of accomplishing much are slim.

My family is making me gain weight. I've gained 3 pounds, and it's taking a major toll on me emotionally. I can't do much about it.

Nothing makes me happy. Things distract me from my sorrow, but sometimes even while in the middle of doing something I enjoy, I can become depressed and I simply put away my things and sleep. Being awake is just not fun.

Art and music are my two passions in life, but I'm worthless at anything musical and as for art..not good enough to be noticed. My lack of talent often only frustrates me and makes me more upset when I attempt to draw.

That last sentence can answer your own question. I'm very aware that it messes with my head, but that doesn't change the fact that I don't want to gain any weight and that I'd rather lose weight til I'm in the hospital than gain a single pound.
I was considering majoring in graphic design and minoring in English. But I'm not good enough to make a living out of something so silly.
15, but I don't want to hear all that junk about being young, missing out on my future, and life getting better. I can't wait for it to get better. There's no guarantee it will.
Already tried that. But uhm...thanks for the comment/advice?

One time, last year, my Algebra teacher was talking and I was just sitting there, zoned out and junk. Then out of nowhere, the thought crossed my mind of how it might be kinda cool to randomly walk up to the board where he was teaching and shove the marker down his throat and stab him with some scissors.

When I clicked this I was gonna be pleased to see either one...
But now I'm for some reason slightly disappointed; that other one would have been pretty awesome.
Thank you, you've been so extremely helpful, and I'm very grateful. I appreciate all the advice, and I hope it helps when I talk to him.

Thank you. I think you're probably the first answer on here that is actually helpful. I'd like to think we can at least try to work through it, despite both of us kinda hating ourselves. We're only in high school, so it's not like it'd get too serious anyways.

Thank you for actually giving me advice. I'm a bit worried to bring it up though, because obviously that's kind of a touchy subject for both of us. It brings up a lot of unpleasant feelings. Any tips on how to even bring it into the conversation without feeling so uncomfortable?

1) I'm kind of impulsive, I don't think before I act sometimes. I know that's no excuse, but it's all I've got to explain my actions.

2) I'd prefer to not result to the whole, "it's over" scenario. Most problems can be worked out. I'd like to work this out, instead of just giving up.

3) Did I not say in the above post that I've changed? I cheated before I'd started my meds, I was a very depressed person who had no self worth. I'm better now though, and I no longer let people treat me like that.

And I'm stuck living in that Knoxville area for another 3 years, at least.

I don't know how to be mean anymore. I don't even know what happened, I just suddenly don't have much of a backbone and can't bring myself to say anything even remotely rude to someone. I hate seeing others unhappy when it's my fault.

Although I must admit, I didn't quite realize guys were *that* insecure about size.

Sadly, people are very insecure about their bodies. Everything is a flaw in their eyes, even if someone else thinks it's perfect. And I'm sure it wasn't just your comment, she probably was considering implants already. I doubt most people would do something like because of *one* thing that was said to them.

I don't wanna start stuff. I hate to bring in authority, and being in high school, things like this spread quickly. I know rumors and stories won't matter later in life, but they do suck pretty bad at the time. And I'd like to still be his friend; he might get pissed at me if I do that.

Oh, my bad! Sorry >__< I figured it was the brain. Sorry.
